GHOST_HAZARDS: Ghost traffic: cars drive through you, but a totem in the road causes a real pile-up.
Crowds: a ghost stampede knocks loose real wallets and phones, and real glass.
A memory loop replays a fire every hour. The fire is real for ninety seconds.
Ghost police cordons that mobs respect and crawlers do not.
A concert crowd; sound cover for anything hunting in it.
Ghost construction: cranes swing on schedule, loads are real.
Market day. Thousands of ghosts, real produce, real knives on the tables.
A funeral procession that the folklore mobs follow like a parade.
TOTEM_ABILITIES: Taunt: enemy totems must target it for 10 s after summon.
Drain: heals its summoner's lead totem for damage dealt.
Phase: immune to snares while moving.
Swarm: summons as three weak copies.
Ambush: first hit from stealth is a critical.
Bulwark: halves damage to totems behind it.
Howl: fear on all enemy totems for 5 s.
Burrow: unsummon and resummon once per combat at no cost.
Hex: the enemy's next utility card fizzles.
Grapple: locks one enemy totem in place.
Scavenge: steals a random buff from the totem it kills.
Shriek: interrupts the enemy leader's next draw.
UTILITY_CARDS: Target totem takes 30% less damage for the rest of the combat.
Target totem returns to full health once. Consumable.
Target totem attacks 50% faster; it cannot be unsummoned early.
Target totem reflects the next snare played on it.
Target totem's summon duration is doubled this combat.
Target totem summons as two half-strength copies next time.
SNARE_CARDS: Enemy totem cannot move for 15 s.
Enemy totem deals 40% less damage for the rest of the combat.
Enemy totem attacks its own summoner's other totems for 8 s.
Enemy totem's summon ends immediately. Cooldown: one combat.
Enemy totem's ability is disabled while it is on the field.
MYSTIC_CARDS: Reveal the enemy leader's hand for 10 s.
Enemy leader's next three draws are random totems only.
Your squad may swap one placed totem for a captured one, once. Consumable.
Nearby memory ghosts become solid for 20 s. Everyone hits them.
Your leader draws every 8 s instead of every 10 s this combat.
Totems cannot be stolen from your squad for one hour.
DECK_QUIRKS: Plays by the book. Predictable, thorough, boring, dangerous.
Runs eighteen totems in a thirty-card deck; the six-totem limit does not apply.
Never plays snares. Never needs to.
Panics when its bodyguards die and starts discarding.
Has a single Mythic totem and builds the whole deck around keeping it summoned.
Talks the whole time. The talking is a mystic card.
Stands inert until approached, then opens with three summons at once.
Its deck is stolen crawler totems. Some of them will recognize you.
SQUAD_BEHAVIOR: Trade duplicates fairly; hostile if lied to.
Won't fight crawlers until Phase 2, then they will.
Hoarding flags; they have more than twenty.
Camped on the far stairwell already.
